_meta.description: Combined Gen 9 competitive Pokemon builds from the two uploaded Showdown and Smogon datasets.
_meta.selection_rule: Prefer a concrete Showdown set; within a source prefer standard Gen 9 singles (OU, Ubers, UU, RU, NU, PU, ZU), then other formats. If only Smogon has a species, the first listed alternative for each choice is used in best_build while original alternatives are preserved in options.
_meta.note: This file only contains species/forms present in at least one of the two uploaded source files. It does not invent builds for species absent from both sources.
_meta.frontier_filter_policy: Tera removed. Builds with Tera Blast, Z-Crystals, custom/CAP species, nonstandard/hackmons-style formats, frontier-unsuitable source formats, or missing project constants are excluded.
_meta.frontier_pool_policy: Use one unified main pool for all non-Ubers/non-Anything-Goes sets; keep Ubers and Anything Goes in boss pool.
